title: The Fighting Fourth
requirements: Reach the past through the opening Wings of the Goddess missions.
For a first Campaign enlistment, obtain the Blue Recommendation Letter from Turbulent Storm in The Eldieme Necropolis [S].
steps: Speak with Turbulent Storm at J-9 in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] and accept the Blue Recommendation Letter. The Batallia Downs [S] J-10 entrance reaches this section.
Travel to Bastok Markets [S] and speak to Adelbrecht near the Auction House at E-8. Accept enlistment and receive the Battle Rations key item.
Leave for North Gustaberg [S]. Enter Zegham Hill’s ascending path near I-8 and follow its ramps to Gebhardt at the Eduard Watchtower, I-6. Speak to him to deliver the rations.
Speak to Roderich at E-11 in North Gustaberg [S]. Then examine the Barricade at E-7 in the same zone.
Return to Adelbrecht in Bastok Markets [S] to finish and join Bastok’s Campaign army.
notes: This is the Bastok enlistment quest, numbered B-00 here; it precedes the twelve story quests.
The first Campaign enlistment grants Sprinter’s Shoes and the Bronze Ribbon of Service. Joining another Campaign nation later is a separate allegiance decision.
The source has unfinished checks around existing Campaign allegiance. The guide is written for a first enlistment; it does not confirm switching rules.
reward: Fourth Division Soldier title; Bastok Campaign allegiance. First enlistment also grants Sprinter’s Shoes and Bronze Ribbon of Service.
unlocks: B-01: Better Part of Valor
Bastok Campaign services

title: Better Part of Valor
requirements: Complete one Campaign enlistment quest: The Fighting Fourth, Steamed Rams, or Snake on the Plains.
Bring one Gnole Claw for the later trade.
steps: Exit Bastok Markets [S] into North Gustaberg [S] for the opening scene and Clump of Animal Hair key item.
Speak with Engelhart outside the music shop in Bastok Markets [S], K-10.
Return to North Gustaberg [S] and examine the ??? at F-8 beside Drachenfall, on the right side of the waterfall.
Speak to Leadavox at J-6 in Vunkerl Inlet [S], then trade her one Gnole Claw to obtain the Xhifhut key item.
Return to Engelhart to finish, receive 10,000 gil, and obtain the Warning Letter. Leave and re-enter the zone before starting the next quest.
notes: This story quest is open after any nation’s first enlistment; it does not itself change Campaign allegiance.
Gnole Claws come from gnoles and may also be available through the Auction House. Keep the Warning Letter for later story progression.
unlocks: B-02: Fires of Discontent

title: Fires of Discontent
requirements: Complete B-01: Better Part of Valor and leave/re-enter Bastok Markets [S].
steps: Speak to Engelhart at K-10 to begin, then speak to Pagdako at H-9 in Bastok Markets [S].
Travel to present-day Metalworks and speak with Iron Eater at J-8 near the President’s Office. This step is in the present, not Bastok’s past.
Return to Engelhart in Bastok Markets [S].
In Grauberg [S], enter the cave near the H-5/I-5 border and examine the ??? inside, at the northwestern corner of I-6.
Report to Engelhart, then speak with Gentle Tiger at H-6 outside the Metalworks entrance.
Speak to Engelhart once more to complete the quest.
notes: If Iron Eater has another active quest’s dialogue, speak to him again until the requested scene occurs.
The audited handler has no additional game-day timer for this quest. The preceding quest requests zoning.
unlocks: The Bastok route’s requirement for finishing WotG 2: Back to the Beginning
B-03: Light in the Darkness, after reaching Cait Sith

title: Light in the Darkness
requirements: Complete B-02: Fires of Discontent.
Complete WotG 2: Back to the Beginning; Cait Sith should be the current mission.
Bring 30 Goblin Chocolates or 5,000 gil. Every entrant needs a Mine Shaft Key.
steps: Speak with Gentle Tiger at H-6, Pagdako at H-9, then Blatherix at F-8 in Bastok Markets [S].
Trade Blatherix exactly 30 Goblin Chocolates or 5,000 gil to receive the Mine Shaft Key.
Enter Pashhow Marshlands [S] from Grauberg [S] for the required scene. Entering from another border does not substitute for this step.
Examine the Corroded Door at F-5 in Pashhow Marshlands [S] and select Light in the Darkness to enter Ruhotz Silvermines.
Defeat any seven of the ten Quadav. They begin close to the party; move clear before preparing, then pull manageable groups. Victory triggers once seven are defeated.
After the exit scene, return to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] for the Adaman Ingot.
notes: The native instance spawns nine Sapphirine Quadav and one Sapphire Quadav. The latter can use Benediction; killing it disperses the others temporarily.
A failed attempt can be retried with a replacement key from Blatherix for 10 Goblin Chocolates or 1,000 gil.
The initial next-day wait is a TODO in this quest’s source, so this guide does not require a real-world midnight wait. Completion sets the next quest’s game-day and zoning checks.
unlocks: B-04: Burden of Suspicion, after the next Vana’diel day and a zone change
availability_note: The native instance and seven-kill victory condition are implemented. Its source flags a remaining issue: players are not locked safely during the entry cutscene and can aggro the nearby enemies. This is a known implementation issue, not proof of a successful live run.

title: Burden of Suspicion
requirements: Complete B-03: Light in the Darkness.
Wait until the next Vana’diel day and change zones after that completion.
steps: Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6, then Engelhart at K-10 in Bastok Markets [S].
Enter The Eldieme Necropolis [S]. On map 1, reach the southern room at G-9 and drop through its middle pit.
On map 2, take the eastern passage to map 3. Reach the northern room at I-7 and examine the Sarcophagus on its eastern side.
Return to Gentle Tiger to complete the investigation.
Speak to Blatherix at F-8 to collect the associated Elixir and prepare the next quest’s timer. Keep that Elixir for The Truth Lies Hid.
notes: Orcs guard the Sarcophagus room. Bring a way to avoid or handle aggro and a way home.
The quest completion grants the title. The Elixir comes from Blatherix afterward; that conversation is necessary to open Storm on the Horizon in the audited base.
reward: Assistant Detective title; Elixir from the follow-up conversation with Blatherix.
unlocks: The Bastok route’s requirement for progressing WotG 3: Cait Sith to WotG 4: The Queen of the Dance
B-05: Storm on the Horizon

title: Storm on the Horizon
requirements: Complete B-04: Burden of Suspicion and collect the Elixir from Blatherix.
After collecting it, wait until the next Vana’diel day and leave Bastok Markets [S].
steps: If not already done, speak to Blatherix at F-8 for the Elixir. The next-day timer starts with this conversation.
Once a new Vana’diel day has begun, enter Bastok Markets [S] on foot from North Gustaberg [S] to watch the opening scene.
Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6.
In North Gustaberg [S], climb Zegham Hill from its I-8 path. Follow the rising ramps around the hill and examine the Monument at the summit, J-7.
Go to Grauberg [S]. Enter the cave near the H-5/I-5 border and examine the ??? at the northwest of I-6, the same point used for Fires of Discontent. Receive the Icarus Wing to complete the quest.
notes: Warping or Retrace into Bastok does not trigger the opening boundary scene.
The native start checks Burden of Suspicion and the Blatherix timer. The next quest, Fire in the Hole, additionally requires WotG 8: In the Name of the Father.
unlocks: B-06: Fire in the Hole, after reaching WotG 8: In the Name of the Father

title: Fire in the Hole
requirements: Complete B-05: Storm on the Horizon.
Reach WotG 8: In the Name of the Father.
Silvermine Key for the reference battle; bring healing and crowd control for an escort fight.
steps: Enter Bastok Markets [S] from North Gustaberg [S]. Finish both opening scenes to obtain the Silvermine Key.
Examine the Stonehoused Adit near the northern edge of E-9 in North Gustaberg [S] for a scene. In the complete reference route, examine it again to enter Fire in the Hole.
Inside Ruhotz Silvermines, prepare the party before speaking to Adelheid to start her escort. Keep her alive as successive Quadav groups converge on her.

Use area damage to take enemies off Adelheid, then control surplus enemies with sleep while healing her. Watch for later waves arriving behind the first group; do not advance or rest while attackers still threaten her.
At the final turret, defeat the remaining Quadav. The objective ends when Adelheid reaches the turret; attacking the turret is not the goal.
After victory and the exit scene, enter Bastok Markets [S] from North Gustaberg [S]. Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6 twice to receive both final scenes and the reward.
notes: Reference retry: obtain another Silvermine Key from Solitary Ant at J-9 in North Gustaberg [S]. Retail references require a new game day and zoning; the incomplete native replacement handler does not establish that wait.
This is an escort objective. A level-75 party needs control and healing as well as damage; no live solo or Trust compatibility is claimed.
reward: Intended: Republican Silver Medal; Mythril Musketeer No. 6 title.
unlocks: The Bastok route’s requirement for continuing WotG 8: In the Name of the Father
B-07: Quelling the Storm, after reaching Crossroads of Time
availability_note: The audited server base explicitly marks the Fire in the Hole battle in Ruhotz Silvermines as unimplemented. The scenes and follow-up handlers exist, but this quest cannot be completed normally through that base alone. Battle and post-battle steps below document the intended route for future implementation.

title: Quelling the Storm
requirements: Complete B-06: Fire in the Hole.
Reach WotG 15: Crossroads of Time.
Bring one Goblin Mess Tin, one Goblin Mushpot, and one Twinkle Powder.
steps: Enter Bastok Markets [S] from North Gustaberg [S] for the opening scene, then speak with Gentle Tiger at H-6.
Speak with all three witnesses in Bastok Markets [S]: Paul at H-5, Biggorf at H-10, and Wilhelmina at I-9. Their order does not matter.
Return to Gentle Tiger. Then speak with Blatherix at F-8.
Trade Blatherix one Goblin Mess Tin, one Goblin Mushpot, and one Twinkle Powder together in a single trade.
Speak to Gentle Tiger again, then examine the ??? just east of the bridge at F-6 in Vunkerl Inlet [S].
Return to Blatherix for the Goblin Belt and completion.
notes: If Blatherix does not request the items, check that all three witnesses and the following Gentle Tiger scene were completed.

Goblin Mushpots can be bought from Pawkrix in Lower Jeuno, H-10. Upih Khachla in northern Windurst Waters, H-9, sells Twinkle Powder. Goblin Mess Tins are beastman drops and may be available on the Auction House.
The native opening scene requires the North Gustaberg [S] border; it has no additional game-day check.
unlocks: B-08: Honor Under Fire
availability_note: This quest’s dialogue and progression are present in the audited base, but its Bastok storyline prerequisites include unfinished battles. A complete reference route is provided; progression on Zenith needs those earlier battles implemented and tested.

title: Honor Under Fire
requirements: Complete B-07: Quelling the Storm.
Reach WotG 15: Crossroads of Time.
steps: Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6.
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], examine the ??? just beyond the F-6 bridge, then the Beastman Ensign at J-7.
Return to Gentle Tiger to receive the Flare Grenade key item.
Examine the Beastman Ensign at J-7 again for a scene. In the complete reference route, examine it once more to enter Honor Under Fire in Everbloom Hollow.
Defeat Arch Ahriman and the false allies it creates. When it transforms into Volker, Five Moons, or Nicolaus, defeat that replica and resume damaging the Ahriman when it returns.
Be ready to recover enemy attention after a transformation. Keep healers clear of area attacks, prepare for sleep, and interrupt dangerous spells where possible.
After winning, return to Gentle Tiger for the final scene and Elixir Tank.
notes: The reference fight lasts 30 minutes. The Ahriman and Nicolaus replica use strong magic; physical damage and a dedicated healer are useful at level 75.
A replacement Flare Grenade comes from Gentle Tiger after a failed attempt in the reference route.
Keep the Elixir Tank or an Elixir for The Truth Lies Hid.
unlocks: The Bastok route’s requirement for continuing WotG 15: Crossroads of Time

title: Beneath the Mask
requirements: Complete B-08: Honor Under Fire.
Reach WotG 26: Fate in Haze.
Bring one Beeswax and one Red Textile Dye.
steps: Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6, then enter Beadeaux [S] for a scene. Its entrance is reached from Pashhow Marshlands [S] at L-11.
Return to Gentle Tiger for the next scene.
Speak with Red Axe at I-8 in The Eldieme Necropolis [S].
Trade Leadavox at J-6 in Vunkerl Inlet [S] one Beeswax and one Red Textile Dye together to receive the Wax Seal.
Return to Red Axe with the Wax Seal, then speak with Gentle Tiger again.
Examine the Hoarfang at F-10 in Beaucedine Glacier [S], on the dark structure in the middle of that map square. Collect the Super Reraiser to complete the quest.
notes: Leave inventory space for the final item; the reward must be received to complete the quest.
The native start checks the previous quest and Fate in Haze; it does not enforce the additional game-day wait listed by retail walkthroughs.

title: What Price Loyalty
requirements: Complete B-09: Beneath the Mask.
Reach WotG 26: Fate in Haze.
steps: Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6 to receive the Sack of Victuals.
Deliver it by speaking to Roderich at E-11 in North Gustaberg [S]. Return to Gentle Tiger for the following scene.
Enter Xarcabard [S] to receive the Commander’s Endorsement.
Examine the Forbidding Portal in the northwest of I-7 for a scene. In the complete reference route, examine it again to enter What Price Loyalty in Everbloom Hollow.

Defeat Klara. Establish a tank quickly, keep her enfeebled, and reserve healing for her sword attacks. Later in the fight, Temblor Blade adds area petrification and disrupts enemy attention; keep a healer able to use Stona outside the area.
After victory, finish the Xarcabard [S] exit scene and return to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] for the Fourth Staff.
notes: Reference retry: Gentle Tiger replaces a lost Commander’s Endorsement without an added game-day wait.
This battle is a 30-minute reference encounter. Current retail level-99 and Trust shortcuts are not a verified plan for Zenith’s level-75 setting.
unlocks: The Bastok route’s requirement for continuing WotG 26: Fate in Haze

title: The Truth Lies Hid
requirements: Complete B-10: What Price Loyalty.
Reach WotG 38: Adieu, Lilisette.
Bring one Elixir.
steps: Speak to Gentle Tiger at H-6. Enter Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] for a scene before proceeding to Castle Zvahl Keep [S].
On Keep map 1, find Rikke at G-7 (northwest), Rakke at G-10 (southwest), and Rokke at H-10 (southeast). Listen to the statements following their requests for an Elixir.
Choose the truthful Imp from the day’s statements. If Rikke says Rikke is honest, Rakke says Rikke is lying, and Rokke says Rikke is honest, choose Rakke.
If Rikke says Rokke is lying, Rakke says Rokke is honest, and Rokke says Rikke is lying, choose Rikke.
If Rikke says Rokke is lying, Rakke says Rikke is honest, and Rokke says Rikke is lying, choose Rokke.
Trade the Elixir to the correct Imp. The item is not consumed. If wrong, wait for the next Vana’diel day and read the new statements before trying again.
Continue through the Keep’s teleporters to map 3. Examine the ??? in the southwest room at G-9.
Drop to the central room, use the central teleporter, and examine the Displaced Block for the final scene and Sanctus Rosary.
notes: The puzzle changes with the Vana’diel day. Do not use yesterday’s answer after midnight; the native script permits one Elixir attempt each game day.
Save the Sanctus Rosary for the final reference battle in Bonds of Mythril.
The native quest checks the main mission gate and prior quest completion, without an initial extra day wait.

title: Bonds of Mythril
requirements: Complete B-11: The Truth Lies Hid.
Reach WotG 38: Adieu, Lilisette.
Keep the Sanctus Rosary and prepare a party for the open-area monster and final reference battle.

start.npc: Main entrance from Castle Zvahl Keep [S]

steps: Leave Castle Zvahl Keep [S] through its main entrance into Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] for the opening scene. Then return to the Keep.
Use the teleporters to reach the southwest room at G-9 on Keep map 3. Examine the ??? for a scene.
Return to that map’s central room and defeat all four Keep Imps after the scene. Kills made before it do not count.
Examine the ??? again to spawn Gargouille Warden. Defeat it, then examine the ??? once more to receive the Zvahl Passkey.
Enter Throne Room [S] and examine the Throne Room door for a scene. In the complete reference route, examine the door again to enter Bonds of Mythril.
First defeat Klara while keeping your allied Zeid alive. Prepare to remove petrification and curse from her special sword attacks. Zeid’s defeat ends the attempt.

Then defeat Marquis Amon. Equip the Sanctus Rosary to block the Doom associated with its draw-in attack, and prepare to heal through area magic. Both phases share the reference battle’s 30-minute limit.
After victory, speak with Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S]. Finish the linked scenes through present-day Metalworks and North Gustaberg [S] to receive the Excelsis Ring.
notes: Gargouille Warden resists magical damage and adds stun to melee hits; prepare for a sustained physical fight.
All participants in the reference Throne Room encounter must be on this quest or have completed it. Live eligibility and Trust behavior remain unverified.
After completion, Naji in present-day Metalworks offers optional closing dialogue. Modern Trust and Atma rewards are outside this level-75 guide.
reward: Intended: Excelsis Ring; Temperer of Mythril title.
unlocks: The Bastok route’s requirement for continuing WotG 38: Adieu, Lilisette
